notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). Chapters come from StrategyWiki page names. StrategyWiki has no separate page for the Remastered edition; its "God of War III" page (categories include PlayStation 3 and PlayStation 4) is at completion stage 2. Its "Table of Contents" (about 2,100 characters) lists walkthrough pages from "Gaia" and "Mount Olympus" to "The Labyrinth", plus challenge and collectible pages. Only 7 subpages exist: "Weapons" (about 12,200 characters), "Items" (about 8,800), "Controls" (about 5,100), "Trophies" (about 4,600), "Table of Contents", "Gaia" (about 1,300) and "Mount Olympus" (about 250). The other walkthrough pages are linked but not created, so the guide was not used as a walkthrough; only the page names were used to group chapters, in their contents order. The contents page lists "The Forge", "The Flame of Olympus", "The Upper Gardens" and "The Caverns" twice (the second time as "2" pages), so the chapters follow that order. godofwar.fandom.com answers the API under "God of War III", with about 194 linked pages, including "Gaia", "Hades", "River Styx" and "Labyrinth"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. No Steam app (steam is none). RAWG lists a playtime of only 6 hours, which looks low.
